# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are released for the latest GradeShelf version only. Update to the
[latest release](https://github.com/14flavius/GradeShelf/releases/latest) before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for security problems.

Report them privately through
[GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/14flavius/GradeShelf/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected version, how the instance is set up and the steps to reproduce.
Remove secrets, session cookies and personal data from logs and screenshots.

You will get a reply as soon as possible. GradeShelf is maintained by one person in
their spare time, so please allow a few days. Fixes are published as a new release
and credited in the advisory unless you prefer otherwise.
